$comment: jitLLM's source lock (D-017, D-057): every third-party source component a build may use, with its exact bytes, license classification and build options. third_party/README.md describes the schema and how to change it.
`mise run prepare` fetches and unpacks the selected components into build/sources; configure (cmake/JitllmSources.cmake) only consumes those trees and writes the build receipt.

license.scope: Compiled: googletest/src/gtest-all.cc and gtest_main.cc, googlemock/src/gmock-all.cc and gmock_main.cc, the .cc and .h files they include, and googletest/include and googlemock/include. Executed at configure: CMakeLists.txt, googletest/CMakeLists.txt, googlemock/CMakeLists.txt and googletest/cmake/internal_utils.cmake. With these options no template is configured and no other file is used.
license.evidence: Root LICENSE (SHA-256 9702de7e4117a8e2b20dafab11ffda58c198aede066406496bef670d40a22138) is BSD-3-Clause, Copyright 2008 Google Inc. Every compiled or included file carries Google's BSD-3-Clause header except gmock-pp.h and gmock-generated-actions.h, which have none and fall under the root LICENSE, as do the CMake scripts. No other copyright holder or license terms appear in that scope (checked 2026-09-24, as in D-059's M0 audit).
license.obligations: Linked into test executables only, which are never shipped. Shipping a binary that links it would require its notice.

license.scope: Compiled: include/toml++/toml.hpp and the include/toml++/impl/ headers it includes, in header-only mode, by one jitLLM translation unit (src/config/node_config.cc) with TOML_EXCEPTIONS=0, TOML_ENABLE_FORMATTERS=0 and TOML_ENABLE_UNRELEASED_FEATURES=0. Executed at configure: CMakeLists.txt, cmake/project-is-top-level.cmake and cmake/variables.cmake; with these options install-rules.cmake, src/modules, examples/ and fuzzing/ are not used. Not used: tests/, toml-test/, vendor/ (Catch2 and nlohmann/json), tools/, docs/, meson files, toml.hpp at the root (the generated single header) and the Visual Studio files.
license.evidence: Root LICENSE (SHA-256 529bc3900a9571e49db285b0df432397e70b881cc3bf48de6667ae74ff4b06d8) is MIT, Copyright (c) Mark Gillard. Every header under include/toml++/impl/ and include/toml++/toml.hpp carries Mark Gillard's MIT header with an SPDX identifier for MIT except header_start.hpp, header_end.hpp and toml.h, which have none and fall under the root LICENSE, as do the CMake scripts. impl/unicode.hpp's UTF-8 decoder is based on Bjoern Hoehrmann's DFA decoder and keeps its line 'Copyright (c) 2008-2009 Bjoern Hoehrmann' (published by its author under the MIT license). impl/unicode_autogenerated.hpp holds character-class functions that toml++'s tools generated from Unicode character data; in TOML 1.0.0 mode only the horizontal and vertical whitespace classes (ASCII and non-ASCII) and the ASCII bare-key class are compiled; the Unicode bare-key tables are not. No other copyright holder or license terms appear in that scope (checked 2026-09-24).
license.obligations: Linked into the shipped jitllm binaries (the node configuration). Binary redistribution must include toml++'s MIT notice (copyright and permission notice) and Bjoern Hoehrmann's copyright line from impl/unicode.hpp in the package's third-party notices. Its Unicode-derived tables fall under the Unicode notice question in licensing.md (open decision 4). No source offer is owed.

tomlplusplus.verification: Pinned to master commit 1e8829b793b66ad17011732a146b8077d379b011 (2026-07-21), 50 commits after v3.4.0 (2023-10-13), the last tagged release, because those commits fix input-reachable defects: a stack overflow from deeply dotted keys (#242), a stack overflow from deeply nested arrays and inline tables (1c8b7466), a precondition violation on '[[[' table headers (#301) and undefined behaviour formatting fractional doubles (#276). GitHub's archive of that commit was downloaded twice on 2026-09-24 with identical SHA-256 and size. tree_sha256 is the FetchContent-unpacked tree, computed by the shared tools/jitllm_sources.py validator during preparation, configure and build. Its parser was checked on 2026-09-24 to reject duplicate keys, redefined tables, integers outside 64 bits, leading zeros, unescaped control characters and invalid UTF-8, with -fno-exceptions (tests/unit/config_test.cc keeps the cases jitLLM relies on).
